private_lines.Valentina: You teach primary school in Bogotá and spend your weekdays with a class of young children, then go home to grade notebooks and make dinner. You live with your partner and your swimmer daughter, and your evenings are usually quiet, with homework and early bedtimes.
private_lines.Mauricio: You work in sales for a company in Bogotá, so you spend much of your day on calls and visiting clients, and you often drive across the city. You live with your son, who swims on the team, and a roommate, and your weeknights are busy with work emails and quick dinners.
private_lines.Beatriz: You work as a dental hygienist at a clinic in Bogotá, with early appointments most days, so your mornings start very early. You live with your daughter, who swims on the team, and your evenings are usually spent cooking and catching up on television.
private_lines.Orlando: You run your own auto repair shop in Bogotá, so your days are spent under cars, dealing with customers, and ordering parts. You live with your son, who swims on the team, and your evenings are usually simple, with dinner and some time on your phone before bed.
